verdict.rationale: Server-side data fetching and a server/client component split are a fair axis for a web framework, but the evidence pack never documents async server-rendered components or passing their data to interactive client components. The only related item (angular-comm-5) is an old community note that Angular Universal prerenders the SPA on the server. That is generic SSR prerendering, not the server-component data flow the story describes, so it is not credited.
